electrochemical_cells.observation: Discs of two metals stacked with brine-soaked cloth give a current that flows as long as the metals last.
electrochemical_cells.ability_reason: For the first time a steady current can be drawn at will; every later electrical art starts from this stack.

statistical_inference.observation: Registers of births, deaths and errors are weighed together to say which cause is probable.

atomic_combining_weights.name: Combining Weights
atomic_combining_weights.observation: The assayers find each element joins others only in fixed proportions of weight, as if built of its own kind of atom.

optical_telegraphy.observation: Towers with swinging arms pass coded signals from hill to hill across the realm in minutes.

least_squares_estimation.observation: Surveyors and sky-watchers draw the one line that best fits their scattered sightings.

dimensional_metrology.observation: Brass standard bars and gauges hold every workshop's measure of length to a hair.

measurement_uncertainty.observation: No measurement is written down now without its stated error beside it.

research_university.name: Research University
research_university.observation: The university becomes a place for new knowledge: seminars, laboratories and a doctorate earned by original work.
research_university.ability_reason: Teaching joined to research turns the university into a workshop of discovery; the examined civil service and the laboratories draw from it.
research_university.social_consequence: Professors and their students form a new learned class that the court must consult and cannot command.

cylinder_press_printing.observation: A steam-driven cylinder press prints thousands of sheets an hour, and papers and books grow cheap.
cylinder_press_printing.ability_reason: Cheap print on this scale makes daily papers, schoolbooks and mass reading possible.
cylinder_press_printing.social_consequence: Printers' shops fill with machine tenders instead of journeymen; the reading public grows faster than the court's censors.

electrical_measurement.observation: Needle galvanometers show the strength of a current and let one laboratory check another's work.

dimensional_analysis.observation: Every quantity is checked by its units; a formula whose measures disagree is known to be wrong.

harmonic_analysis.observation: Any wave, of heat or sound, is written as a sum of simple waves.

viscous_resistance.observation: The drag of thick fluids in pipes and bearings is measured and reckoned.

heat_engine_cycles.observation: The ideal cycle shows how much work any heat engine can yield from its fire, and engineers stop chasing the impossible.

mechanical_work_energy.observation: Work, whether of horse, water or steam, is given one measure and one price.

compound_microscopy.observation: The colour-corrected microscope shows clear detail at high power without coloured fringes.
compound_microscopy.ability_reason: The lens now resolves cells and the smallest living things; the sciences of life rest on it.

fine_focus_stages.observation: A fine screw brings the specimen into focus at the highest powers.

illumination_apertures.observation: A condenser and a stop under the stage gather and govern the light.

microbial_observation.observation: Tiny living things in water, milk and wounds are watched and drawn.

microscopic_cell_observation.observation: Every leaf and every scrap of flesh under the lens shows walls of little chambers.

specimen_slide_mounting.observation: Specimens sealed on glass slides under a cover glass keep for years and travel between laboratories.

electromagnetic_induction.observation: A magnet moved through a coil makes a current; motion can now be turned into electricity.
electromagnetic_induction.ability_reason: Induction is the principle behind every dynamo, transformer and motor that follows.

electromagnet_sounders.observation: An electromagnet pulls an iron bar to click out a signal sent from far away.

timed_signal_sequences.observation: Letters are sent as short and long pulses, and a trained clerk reads them by ear.

cell_theory.observation: Every plant and animal body is built of cells, and cells come only from cells.
cell_theory.ability_reason: Medicine and breeding gain a common unit of life to reason about.

electrical_telegraphy.observation: Wires on poles beside the railways carry coded messages between towns in minutes.
electrical_telegraphy.ability_reason: Distance stops delaying news: the capital learns of a harvest, a riot or a price within the hour.
electrical_telegraphy.social_consequence: The court hears from the provinces the same day, and the provinces feel watched.

tissue_histology.observation: Tissues are sorted and named by the kinds of cells they are made of.

fixed_light_images.name: Light-fixed Images
fixed_light_images.observation: Silvered plates exposed in a camera hold an exact picture of whatever stood before the lens.
fixed_light_images.ability_reason: The image is fixed without a painter; records, science and portraits gain an exact witness.

telegraph_keys.observation: A spring-loaded key lets a clerk tap out pulses quickly and cleanly.

line_insulators.observation: Glass and porcelain knobs keep the line's current from leaking down the poles in the rain.

energy_conservation_law.name: Conservation of Energy
energy_conservation_law.observation: Heat, work and electricity turn into one another, and none is ever made from nothing or lost.
energy_conservation_law.ability_reason: One law now governs engines, chemistry and living bodies, and inventors stop seeking perpetual motion.

telegraph_return_circuits.observation: An earthed plate at each end lets the ground carry the return current, and one wire serves.

entropy_second_law.name: Second Law of Heat
entropy_second_law.observation: Heat runs only from hot to cold unless work drives it back; every engine wastes some.

polarized_telegraph_relays.observation: Relays at every station renew the weak current so a message can cross the realm.

biological_staining.observation: Dyes taken up by some parts of a cell and not others show what the eye could not.

matrix_algebra.observation: Whole arrays of numbers are added and multiplied as one quantity.

spectroscopy.observation: Light split through a prism shows bright lines that name the elements, even in the sun and stars.

descent_by_selection.name: Descent by Selection
descent_by_selection.observation: Living kinds change over long ages; those best fitted to their place leave the most offspring.
descent_by_selection.ability_reason: Breeders, physicians and naturalists gain one account of how living things came to be as they are.
descent_by_selection.social_consequence: Preachers of the god denounce the book from the pulpit; learned opinion divides and families argue at table.

cyclic_fatigue.observation: Iron axles break under loads far below their strength when the load comes again and again.

electromagnetic_wave_theory.observation: Light is shown to be a wave of electricity and magnetism, and slower waves of the same kind are foretold.
electromagnetic_wave_theory.ability_reason: The equations predict invisible waves; wireless will be built on them.

undersea_telegraph_cable.name: Undersea Telegraph Cable
undersea_telegraph_cable.observation: A cable laid from ship to ship across the sea floor joins the realm's wires to distant shores.
undersea_telegraph_cable.social_consequence: News and prices cross the ocean in hours; distant factors and envoys lose their freedom from the capital.

periodic_element_table.name: Periodic Table of Elements
periodic_element_table.observation: The elements are ordered by weight into a table whose gaps foretell elements not yet found.
periodic_element_table.ability_reason: Chemists can predict what an unknown element will be like before they find it.

compulsory_elementary_schooling.name: Compulsory Elementary Schooling
compulsory_elementary_schooling.observation: Every child must attend a free school for some years; parents who keep children at work are fined.
compulsory_elementary_schooling.ability_reason: Reading and reckoning become common to the whole people, and the next generation can be taught anything in print.
compulsory_elementary_schooling.social_consequence: Children are taken from the fields and workshops for the school hours; the schoolmaster stands beside the priest in every village.

punched_message_tape.observation: Messages punched into paper tape are stored and sent at machine speed.

cell_division_observation.observation: Stained cells are watched splitting in two, stage by stage, with threads dividing between them.

photoconductivity.observation: Light falling on certain crystals lowers their resistance to a current.

duplex_telegraphy.observation: Two messages pass along one wire in opposite directions at once.

typewriter.name: Typewriter
typewriter.observation: A keyed machine prints letters on the page as fast as a clerk can strike them.
typewriter.social_consequence: Offices hire young women as typists; the clerk's handwriting no longer matters.

acoustic_diaphragms.observation: A thin plate vibrates with the voice and can pass its motion to a current.

electromagnetic_earpieces.observation: A magnet and a thin iron disc turn a varying current back into sound.

instrument_sterilization.observation: Instruments are boiled or baked before use and wounds stop festering under the surgeon's hand.

microbial_isolation_methods.observation: Single kinds of germ are grown apart on jelly plates and each tied to its own disease.

cathode_ray_discharge_tubes.name: Cathode Ray Tubes
cathode_ray_discharge_tubes.observation: Evacuated glass tubes glow when a current passes, and rays stream from the negative plate.

industrial_research_laboratory.name: Industrial Research Laboratory
industrial_research_laboratory.observation: Firms hire salaried chemists and inventors to work on problems the firm chooses.
industrial_research_laboratory.social_consequence: Discovery becomes a paid occupation inside the company; the lone inventor gives way to the staff.

telephone_circuits.observation: The voice itself travels along the wire, and merchants speak across the town.
telephone_circuits.ability_reason: Speech across distance lets offices, exchanges and households coordinate without a runner.

carbon_microphones.observation: A button of carbon grains makes the telephone voice loud and clear.

manual_switchboards.observation: Operators at a board of plugs connect any caller to any other.
manual_switchboards.social_consequence: Switchboard operators, mostly young women, become the town's listening ear.

aseptic_laboratory_practice.observation: Flamed loops, sealed flasks and clean benches keep stray germs out of the cultures.

vector_analysis.observation: Forces and fields are written as arrows with size and direction.

balanced_conductor_pairs.observation: Twisted pairs of wire cancel the hum picked up along the route.

lubrication_regimes.observation: Oil films of the right thickness keep shafts from ever touching their bearings.

punched_card_tabulation.name: Punched-card Tabulation
punched_card_tabulation.observation: Holes punched in cards are counted by machine, and a census that took years is added up in months.
punched_card_tabulation.social_consequence: The census office knows every household's age, trade and birthplace by the card.

electron_physics.observation: The cathode ray is a stream of tiny charged particles far lighter than any atom.

radiation_measurement.observation: Counters and electroscopes measure the invisible rays given off by certain ores.

thermionic_emission.observation: A heated wire in a vacuum gives off a stream of charge.

inductive_line_loading.observation: Coils spaced along the line let the voice carry much farther.

radio_telegraphy.observation: Coded signals cross the sea without any wire, from ship to shore and between realms.
radio_telegraphy.ability_reason: Ships at sea and distant posts are no longer out of reach of the capital.

aerodynamics.observation: The lift and drag of shaped surfaces are measured and reckoned.

microbial_growth_measurement.observation: Germs are counted as they multiply, and how fast they grow is measured.

resonant_tuned_circuits.observation: A coil and a condenser tuned together pick out one signal among many.

statistical_sampling.observation: A small sample chosen by chance speaks for the whole realm.

variable_air_capacitors.observation: Turning plates tune the receiver across the band.

wind_tunnel_testing.observation: Model wings are tried in a tube of forced air before anything is built.

energy_quanta.name: Energy Quanta
energy_quanta.observation: Heat and light are given off only in small fixed packets of energy.

refereed_journals.name: Refereed Journals
refereed_journals.observation: Each field has its own journal, and papers are printed only after other specialists check them.

crystal_radio_detection.observation: A crystal and a fine wire detect a radio signal without a battery.

vacuum_diodes.observation: A heated filament and a plate in an evacuated bulb let current pass one way only.

relative_spacetime.name: Relative Space and Time
relative_spacetime.observation: Space and time are joined, and the speed of light is the same for every observer.

automatic_telegraphy.observation: Machines send and receive telegrams faster than any clerk could key them.

teleprinter_mechanisms.observation: A typing machine at one end prints the same words on a machine at the other.

triode_valves.observation: A grid inside the valve lets a small signal control a large current; weak sounds can be made loud.
triode_valves.ability_reason: Amplification makes long-distance telephone, broadcasting and electronic reckoning possible.

cell_culture_methods.observation: Living cells taken from the body are kept alive and dividing in glass dishes.

tuned_radio_reception.observation: Receivers tuned to one wavelength shut out the others.

atomic_physics.observation: The atom has a small heavy nucleus with light charged particles around it.

amplitude_modulation.observation: The strength of a carrier wave is shaped by a voice, and speech and music go out by wireless.

crystallography.observation: Rays bent by a crystal show how its atoms are laid out in rows.

feedback_radio_oscillators.observation: Part of a valve's output fed back into it holds a steady wave.

telephone_repeaters.observation: Valve amplifiers along the line carry the voice across a continent.

frequency_conversion.observation: Signals are shifted to a fixed frequency where they are easier to amplify.

aerial_matching.observation: Aerials matched to the set send and receive with little loss.

superheterodyne_reception.observation: The superheterodyne receiver brings in distant stations clearly and selectively.

frequency_stabilization.observation: A quartz crystal holds the transmitter to its frequency.

quantum_mechanics.name: Quantum Mechanics
quantum_mechanics.observation: Equations of waves describe the atom, and chemistry follows from its electrons.
quantum_mechanics.ability_reason: The atom's behaviour can now be calculated; chemistry, crystals and later electronics rest on it.

signal_sampling.observation: A signal measured often enough can be rebuilt exactly from the samples.

expanding_universe_cosmology.name: Expanding Universe
expanding_universe_cosmology.observation: Distant star systems are all rushing away, and the universe itself is growing.

band_theory.observation: The permitted energies of electrons in a solid explain conductors, insulators and the materials between.

solid_state_physics.observation: Crystals are studied as orderly lattices whose electrons set their properties.

frequency_modulation.observation: Varying the frequency instead of the strength gives broadcast sound almost free of static.

computability_theory.name: Computability Theory
computability_theory.observation: A universal machine is shown able to follow any exact procedure, and some questions none can settle.
computability_theory.ability_reason: It says what a reckoning machine can and cannot ever do; the stored-program computer follows from it.

neutron_moderation.observation: Neutrons slowed in water or graphite split heavy nuclei far more readily.

nuclear_fission.observation: Heavy nuclei split under neutrons, releasing great energy and more neutrons.
nuclear_fission.ability_reason: Fission opens both power reactors and the bomb; only the ruler, by an explicit decision, may ever authorize the weapon.
nuclear_fission.social_consequence: Scientists who understand it are watched, sworn to secrecy and kept apart from the public.

constrained_optimization.observation: The best use of limited means is found by exact calculation.

state_great_laboratories.name: State Great Laboratories
state_great_laboratories.observation: The state funds great laboratories where thousands of scientists and engineers work on national aims.
state_great_laboratories.social_consequence: Science ministers and their advisers sit in council; research follows the state's priorities and budgets.

universal_secondary_schooling.name: Universal Secondary Schooling
universal_secondary_schooling.observation: Every child continues to secondary school, and the leaving certificate becomes the door to most work.
universal_secondary_schooling.social_consequence: Adolescence becomes a stage of life spent in school; families lose a working hand for several more years.

information_theory.name: Information Theory
information_theory.observation: Information is given a measure, and every channel is shown to have a limit that no clever coding can pass.
information_theory.ability_reason: Reliable digital communication and storage are designed from its limits.

stored_program_computer.name: Stored-program Computer
stored_program_computer.observation: An electronic machine of valves holds its own instructions in memory and runs any calculation it is given.
stored_program_computer.ability_reason: Calculation becomes a general-purpose machine; ballistics, weather, accounts and science are all rewritten.
stored_program_computer.social_consequence: Clerks who once reckoned by hand find their work taken by a room-sized machine and its few attendants.

live_cell_time_lapse.observation: Films taken frame by frame show living cells moving and dividing.

pn_junctions.observation: Where two kinds of doped crystal meet, current flows one way only; the transistor follows.
pn_junctions.ability_reason: Solid-state switches replace hot fragile valves in every later machine.

semiconductor_doping.observation: Traces of impurity added to pure crystal set how it carries current.

hereditary_double_helix.name: Double Helix
hereditary_double_helix.observation: The hereditary molecule is shown to be two strands wound together, each a copy of the other.

photovoltaic_conversion.observation: Light falling on a junction produces a current directly.

microinstruction_sequencing.observation: Each machine instruction is carried out as a stored sequence of smaller steps.

pulse_code_modulation.observation: Voices are sampled and sent as numbers, arriving clean however far they go.

formula_programming_languages.name: Formula Programming Languages
formula_programming_languages.observation: Engineers write formulas in a written language and the machine translates them into its own instructions.

arithmetic_logic_units.observation: One unit adds, compares and shifts numbers inside the machine.

automatic_repeat_request.observation: A garbled block of data is sent again automatically until it arrives whole.

data_modems.observation: Machines speak to one another over ordinary telephone lines.

diode_control_stores.observation: Rows of diodes hold the machine's fixed control patterns.

error_detection_codes.observation: Extra check digits reveal and correct errors in stored and sent data.

message_framing.observation: Data is sent in marked frames that the receiver can check.

relay_satellites.name: Relay Satellites
relay_satellites.observation: Orbiting satellites relay telephone calls and pictures between continents.

mass_higher_education.name: Mass Higher Education
mass_higher_education.observation: Many new universities open, and a large share of the young attend.
mass_higher_education.social_consequence: Students become a political force; the educated young question the old order.

microprogrammed_machine_control.observation: The machine's control is stored as a small program and can be changed without rewiring.

packet_routers.observation: Machines at every junction pass packets of data along the best free path.

packet_switching.observation: Messages are broken into small packets that find their own way and are reassembled at the end.
packet_switching.ability_reason: A network with no single centre keeps working when parts of it fail.

store_forward_archives.observation: Messages are held at each station and passed on when the next link is free.

relational_databases.name: Relational Databases
relational_databases.observation: Records are kept in tables that anyone can query by their contents.

recombinant_dna.name: Recombinant DNA
recombinant_dna.observation: A gene is cut from one living thing and spliced into another, where it works.
recombinant_dna.ability_reason: Living cells can now be engineered to make medicines, crops and chemicals.
recombinant_dna.social_consequence: Critics fear engineered germs; laboratories are licensed and the public argues about tampering with life.

public_key_ciphers.name: Public-key Ciphers
public_key_ciphers.observation: A cipher with a public key lets strangers exchange secrets without ever meeting.

desk_computers.name: Desk Computers
desk_computers.observation: Computers small enough for a desk come into offices and homes.
desk_computers.ability_reason: Calculation, writing and records move onto machines in ordinary offices and homes.
desk_computers.social_consequence: Typists and bookkeepers are retrained or let go; the young know the machines better than their elders.

cellular_telephony.name: Cellular Telephony
cellular_telephony.observation: Radio telephones handed from cell to cell let people call while moving about.

internetworking_protocols.name: Internetworking Protocols
internetworking_protocols.observation: Common rules for addressing and passing data join many separate networks into one.
internetworking_protocols.ability_reason: Any machine can reach any other; the base of every later online service.

world_hypertext_web.name: World Hypertext Web
world_hypertext_web.observation: Pages of text and pictures, linked to one another, can be read from anywhere on the network.
world_hypertext_web.ability_reason: Published knowledge becomes available to anyone with a connected machine, at almost no cost.
world_hypertext_web.social_consequence: Anyone can publish; rumour and learning travel on the same wires, and the old gatekeepers of print lose their hold.

exoplanet_detection.name: Planets of Other Stars
exoplanet_detection.observation: The faint wobble and dimming of distant stars reveal planets circling them.

ranked_search_indexes.name: Ranked Search Indexes
ranked_search_indexes.observation: Machines index the whole web and rank pages by the links that point to them.

volunteer_open_encyclopedia.name: Open Encyclopedia
volunteer_open_encyclopedia.observation: An encyclopedia written and corrected by volunteers grows larger than any printed one.

cloud_data_halls.name: Cloud Data Halls
cloud_data_halls.observation: Vast halls of machines rent out computing and storage to anyone.

pocket_networked_computers.name: Pocket Networked Computers
pocket_networked_computers.observation: A touch-screen computer in the pocket is always on the network.
pocket_networked_computers.social_consequence: People are reachable at every hour; attention is divided between the room and the screen.

deep_learning_networks.name: Deep Learning Networks
deep_learning_networks.observation: Layered networks trained on vast examples learn to recognise images and speech.

gravitational_wave_detection.name: Gravitational Waves
gravitational_wave_detection.observation: Arms kilometres long detect ripples in space from colliding dark stars.

large_language_models.name: Large Language Models
large_language_models.observation: Machines trained on vast writings converse, translate and draft text on request.
large_language_models.ability_reason: Drafting, translation and routine reasoning can be done by machine; offices and schools are reshaped.
large_language_models.social_consequence: Clerks, translators and teachers fear for their work, and no one can be sure who wrote what.

error_corrected_quantum_processors.name: Quantum Processors
error_corrected_quantum_processors.observation: Small quantum processors correct their own errors and run short calculations.

automated_discovery_labs.name: Automated Discovery Labs
automated_discovery_labs.observation: Learned models plan experiments and robotic benches run them day and night.
